quy_tac_se_thu.mo_ta: Chon kenh co dinh PSD lon nhat trong dai 1,8-3,0 Hz cua duong bao Hilbert cua tin hieu du (quy tac hien tai, theo Power-MF / Jaeger 2024).

quy_tac_se_thu.loai: tham chieu (KHONG mu nhan ve lich su)
quy_tac_se_thu.mo_ta: Kenh 0 co dinh. Bao cao vi day la quy tac nhom tung chon HAU KIEM va da rut lai; giu de doc gia thay hau qua.
Khong chon gi: trung binh F1 cua 4 kenh (ky vong cua mot kenh lay ngau nhien).
Chon kenh co F1 that cao nhat. Chi de do du dia.

Chay mo hinh tren ca 4 kenh; voi moi kenh tinh diem tin cay cua CONG TU CHOI da hieu chuan = 1 - trung binh xac suat 'doan xau' tren cac doan 4 s. Chon kenh co diem cao nhat. Cong = HistGradientBoostingClassifier tren 12 SQI co dien (fsqi.CLASSICAL_KEYS + peak_prob_mean + prob_max), nhan doan = F1 doan < 80, THAM SO GIU NGUYEN cua analysis/gate22_analyze.py (max_depth 3, max_iter 200, lr 0,05, class_weight balanced, seed 0).
quy_tac_se_thu.sieu_tham_so: khong co sieu tham so moi; tham so cong lay nguyen tu vong truoc
quy_tac_se_thu.chong_ro_ri: 22 chu the: cong huan luyen leave-one-SUBJECT-out. CinC: cong huan luyen tren TOAN BO 22 chu the roi ap zero-shot.

quy_tac_se_thu.mo_ta: Chon kenh co he so bien thien khoang RR (rr_cv) cua chuoi phat hien THAP nhat, tinh tren toan ban ghi. Kenh co < 3 phat hien bi loai.

quy_tac_se_thu.loai: quy tac moi (phu, tu dau ra mo hinh)
quy_tac_se_thu.mo_ta: Chon kenh co trung binh xac suat mo hinh tai cac dinh da phat hien (peak_prob_mean) cao nhat.
Chon kenh co ti le khoang RR nam trong 0,3-0,7 s (110-200 nhip/phut) cao nhat; hoa thi pha bang rr_cv thap hon.

quy_tac_se_thu.loai: quy tac moi (d) -- HOP NHAT thay vi CHON
quy_tac_se_thu.mo_ta: Gop phat hien cua ca 4 kenh: gom cac phat hien cach nhau <= 50 ms thanh mot cum, giu cum nao co it nhat k trong 4 kenh dong gop, vi tri = trung vi cum; ap thoi gian tro 250 ms.
quy_tac_se_thu.sieu_tham_so: k thuoc {1,2,3,4}; CHON DUY NHAT tren 22 chu the roi ap nguyen xi sang CinC. Bao cao ca 4 gia tri k tren ca hai canh de minh bach.

quy_tac_se_thu.loai: quy tac moi (e) -- bo chon kenh hoc
quy_tac_se_thu.mo_ta: HistGradientBoostingRegressor du doan F1 cua tung kenh tu dac trung KHONG NHAN muc ban ghi (trung vi 12 SQI tren cac doan + diem PSD + xep hang trong-ban-ghi cua tung dac trung giua 4 kenh); chon kenh co F1 du doan cao nhat.
quy_tac_se_thu.sieu_tham_so: max_depth 3, max_iter 200, lr 0,05, seed 0 -- CO DINH TRUOC, khong do luoi
quy_tac_se_thu.chong_ro_ri: 22 chu the: leave-one-SUBJECT-out (88 hang = 22 chu the x 4 kenh). CinC: huan luyen tren toan bo 88 hang cua 22 chu the roi ap zero-shot. KHONG huan luyen tren CinC.

KHONG them quy tac moi sau khi da thay ket qua. Neu buoc phai them, phai ghi ro la HAU KIEM va khong duoc coi la bang chung xac nhan.
